title: bardolier service catalogue (services.yml)
description: Editable catalogue of attachable services. cli-spec.md §4.1. Adding a service type is a YAML edit, not a code change.

host_port_base.description: Start of this service's host-port band; the allocator counts upward from here.

volume.description: Named volume; {project} is interpolated with the project name.

mount.description: Container path the named volume mounts at.

env.description: Service container environment; values may contain {project}.

connection_hint.description: Optional template for status's connection_hint (§7), e.g. postgresql://localhost:{host_port}. {host_port}, {container_port} and {project} are interpolated. The bundled services omit it and fall back to the built-in scheme table; supplying it keeps a new service type a YAML-only addition (§4.1).
